description: The card of a file change (lib/approval-preview.mjs): the bounds (20 files, 200 rows, 400 characters, 120,000 characters, 500 characters of a refusal), a line cut at a character and not inside one, the guard of every file of the call and the digest of the arguments, and the body of a private key hidden by its place in the old and the new text, judged by tests/verify-approval-preview.mjs.

mutations.name: AP-files-more
mutations.what: twenty-one files on the card

mutations.name: AP-rows-more
mutations.what: two hundred and one rows of a file

mutations.name: AP-row-chars-more
mutations.what: a line is cut at 401 characters

mutations.name: AP-chars-more
mutations.what: the card holds 130,000 characters

mutations.name: AP-message-more
mutations.what: the message of a refusal is cut at 5000 characters

mutations.name: AP-canonical-sort
mutations.what: the keys of the arguments are not sorted

mutations.name: AP-clip-ending
mutations.what: the line ending is counted in the line

mutations.name: AP-clip-surrogate
mutations.what: a character can be cut in two

mutations.name: AP-clip-omitted
mutations.what: a cut line says it lost all its characters

mutations.name: AP-clip-end
mutations.what: a cut line loses its line ending

mutations.name: AP-clip-limit
mutations.what: a line of exactly the limit is cut

mutations.name: AP-keys-begin
mutations.what: the start of a private key is not recognised

mutations.name: AP-keys-end
mutations.what: the end of a private key is not recognised

mutations.name: AP-keys-body
mutations.what: the lines of a private key body are not hidden

mutations.name: AP-keys-public
mutations.what: a public key is taken for a private one

mutations.name: AP-keys-lead
mutations.what: the rows before the first change are counted wrong

mutations.name: AP-keys-old
mutations.what: the place in the old text does not move

mutations.name: AP-keys-current
mutations.what: the place in the new text does not move

mutations.name: AP-keys-removed
mutations.what: a removed row is looked up in the new text

mutations.name: AP-keys-added
mutations.what: an added row is looked up in the old text

mutations.name: AP-keys-ending
mutations.what: a hidden row loses its line ending

mutations.name: AP-keys-flag
mutations.what: the card does not say that a call touches a private key

mutations.name: AP-keys-flag-old
mutations.what: a key that goes away is not key material

mutations.name: AP-keys-flag-new
mutations.what: a key that appears is not key material

mutations.name: AP-keys-old-text
mutations.what: the old text of a plan is not looked at

patches.old: const oldLines = typeof plan.oldText === 'string' ? privateKeyBodyLines(plan.oldText) : new Set();

mutations.name: AP-keys-new-text
mutations.what: the new text of a plan is not looked at

patches.old: const newLines = typeof plan.newText === 'string' ? privateKeyBodyLines(plan.newText) : new Set();

mutations.name: AP-guard-all
mutations.what: the guard holds the files of the card only

patches.old: files: plans.map((plan) => ({ path: plan.relative, baseSha: plan.baseSha })) };
patches.new: files: plans.slice(0, PREVIEW_LIMITS.files).map((plan) => ({ path: plan.relative, baseSha: plan.baseSha })) };

mutations.name: AP-guard-sha
mutations.what: the guard holds the path and not the hash

mutations.name: AP-guard-tool
mutations.what: a card made for another tool is accepted

mutations.name: AP-guard-args
mutations.what: a card made for other arguments is accepted

mutations.name: AP-guard-files
mutations.what: a card with no list of files is accepted

mutations.name: AP-hidden-files
mutations.what: the files that are not on the card are not counted

mutations.name: AP-truncated-files
mutations.what: files that are not shown do not make the card truncated

mutations.name: AP-rows-hidden
mutations.what: the rows that are not shown are not counted

mutations.name: AP-rows-cut
mutations.what: a hunk that is cut does not say how much

mutations.name: AP-action-create
mutations.what: a new file is an overwrite

mutations.name: AP-error-code
mutations.what: a refusal without a code has none
